label: Hjarni
description: Search and manage Markdown notes, folders and tags

operations.name: get_me
operations.description: Read the account identity and the token's access grants.

operations.name: search_notes
operations.description: Search accessible notes across personal or team spaces.

operations.name: list_notes
operations.description: List one page of accessible notes with optional filters.

operations.name: get_note
operations.description: Read one note including its Markdown body.

operations.name: create_note
operations.description: Create a Markdown note; omitted folder means inbox.

operations.name: update_note
operations.description: Update only supplied note fields; optionally guard against concurrent edits.

operations.name: delete_note
operations.description: Move a note to Trash; does not permanently delete it.

operations.name: archive_note
operations.description: Archive a note.

operations.name: unarchive_note
operations.description: Unarchive a note.

operations.name: move_note
operations.description: Move a note to a folder, or to the inbox if Folder ID is omitted.

operations.name: favorite_note
operations.description: Favorite a note.

operations.name: unfavorite_note
operations.description: Remove a note from favorites.

operations.name: restore_note
operations.description: Restore a note from Trash.

operations.name: list_containers
operations.description: List one page of accessible folders.

operations.name: get_container
operations.description: Read one folder.

operations.name: create_container
operations.description: Create a folder with optional parent and AI instructions.

operations.name: update_container
operations.description: Update supplied folder fields. Root folders cannot be changed.

operations.name: delete_container
operations.description: Move a folder and its contents to Trash.

operations.name: list_container_notes
operations.description: List one page of notes in a folder.

operations.name: list_tags
operations.description: List one page of the account's tags.

operations.name: get_tag
operations.description: Read one tag.

operations.name: create_tag
operations.description: Create a tag.

operations.name: update_tag
operations.description: Rename a tag.

operations.name: delete_tag
operations.description: Delete a tag, removing it from every note.

operations.name: list_tag_notes
operations.description: List one page of notes carrying a tag.
